node.statement: Scope obstruction. The registered definitions merely define extended delta-inclusions and the raw/state data; none declares c_0^cb. The six permitted externals mention c_0^cb only inside hypotheses or defect labels and do not assert that it is fixed, finite, nonnegative, or universal. Consequently the added premise in the amended parent cannot be discharged from the allowed inputs. In particular, without it e_co/(c_0^cb+1) need not be a positive defined radius and K_1 need not be universal. Proving root node 1 therefore requires the shard to permit an upstream result establishing c_0^cb as a finite nonnegative universal constant, or the root contract to state that premise explicitly.
